Every heading below is asked because a reviewer of this repository reads it.
Delete none of them. Where one does not apply, write "none" under it and say
why, because an empty heading and an inapplicable one look the same.
-->

## What changed

## What failure this prevents

<!-- Say what goes wrong in the tree without this change, not what the change
consists of. A change that prevents nothing is a change nobody can review. -->

## Which decision file argued this

<!-- The file under docs/decisions/ that this change follows, by number and
name. If this change makes a choice no decision file covers, say so here: that
is a decision being made in a pull request, and it needs its own file first. -->

## The statements, in words

<!-- Required wherever a public declaration is added or its statement changes.
For each one: its name, and what it claims, in a sentence a physicist would
recognise. Say which hypotheses it needs and what it does not conclude.

A diff of a proof is close to unreadable, and a reviewer who cannot see here
what the new statement claims will review the proof instead of the statement,
which is reviewing the half the machine already checked.

Where no public declaration changed, write "none". -->

## What was run, and what it printed

<!-- The commands, with their output, run at the commit being pushed rather than
in a working tree. Every number stated anywhere in this body appears here with
the command that produced it.

Where a guard is added or changed, this is where it is shown to bite: the run
with the guard deleted, red, and the run with it restored, green.

Where something was not run, say that it was not run and why. A step that was
skipped is written as skipped, never left out. -->

## Closes
